bio: A gem just steps away from the famous Ulica Korzo, in the heart of the city’s pedestrian area. Here, everything revolves around a carefully curated selection of both Croatian and international wines, while Chef Željko offers Mediterranean cuisine with influences from neighboring regions. Worth trying, for example, is the Black Slavonian pig accompanied by carrot variations or the stuffed pasta dishes, which are always creative and well-executed. The menu is constantly evolving, but there are always interesting options to satisfy different tastes. The atmosphere is intimate and informal, enhanced by an attentive, friendly service....
